shell.theme.unsupported: This page only has the dark theme for now.

keys.overlay_hint: Shortcuts are inactive while typing in form fields. Default bindings live in /static/workbench-keys.json.
keys.go_workbench: Go to the workbench (search across all layers)
keys.reserved_timeline: Reserved by the timeline (pan, zoom, clear selection)
keys.reserved_browser: Reserved by the browser (navigation and forms)
palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Type a command, an ID (e.g. a:12, e#7) or the start of a SHA-256
palette.hint: ↑/↓ select · Enter run · Esc close. A number without a kind lists every object with that ID.
index.subtitle: communication evidence · provenance first
index.search.title: Search
index.search.has_more: showing the first {limit}; more results exist. Narrow the query.
index.search.intro: FTS5 indexes message text, transcripts, parser output and metadata. Semantic search can be added as a separate layer without changing the evidence model.
index.search.layered: Search all layers (with a layer filter and annotations) →
artifact.annotation.label: label
artifact.annotation.body: Note / interpretation – kept separate from the source
artifact.derived.title: Other derived texts — bounded preview
artifact.derived.hint: Up to the 50 newest non-transcript texts; preview up to 4096 characters per text. The full selected transcript can be read below.
artifact.derived.more: Further derived texts do not fit in this preview.
artifact.citation.title: Citation from a chosen version
artifact.citation.hint: Select a contiguous passage. The citation keeps the exact text and version. Word times are ASR output; browser playback is approximate and does not confirm that recognition matches the audio.
artifact.citation.full_text: Full text of the selected transcript version
artifact.citation.package_hint: The metadata package contains the full pinned transcript version and recorded provenance; it does not contain the recording. Consider the content of the whole version before sharing.
artifact.events.title: Events from this source
artifact.events.hint: Preview of up to 100 events and up to 4096 characters of body/subject per event.
artifact.events.more: Further events do not fit in this preview.
epistemic.raw_source_field.help: value as recorded at acquisition (name, locator, client metadata); not verified
epistemic.parser_output.help: projection of a raw record by a deterministic parser; time and direction are the parser's interpretation
epistemic.model_output.help: ASR/OCR or other model output; may contain recognition errors; run recorded or unknown
epistemic.human_annotation.help: a person's note, label or interpretation; not source material
epistemic.unclassified.help: text kind unknown to this classification; the layer is not guessed
action.workbench_folder_item_add: added a reference to a folder
action.workbench_folder_item_remove: removed a reference from a folder
wb.error.work_limit: Search work limit exceeded. Narrow the query or the layers.
wb.title: Workbench
wb.subtitle: search across all layers · saved searches · bulk tags · folders
wb.search.title: Search across all layers
wb.search.label: FTS5 query
wb.search.placeholder: Search: "phrase" OR term (works without Polish diacritics too)
wb.search.layers_hint: Nothing ticked = all layers. Every hit states its layer: source field, parser output, model output or human annotation.
wb.search.intro: One query searches artifact metadata, events, transcripts, OCR, other derived text and annotations. Layer counts are computed by code; results are never stored as truth.
wb.search.has_more: showing the first {limit}; more results exist. Narrow the query or the layers.
wb.search.facets_partial: Layer counts cover the first {n} hits; they are lower bounds.
wb.search.index_note: The workbench index (workbench_fts) is separate from the legacy search_fts. The extra ł→l folding exists only in the index; stored text is unchanged.
wb.bulk.title: Bulk tagging
wb.bulk.hint: Tick results (the event, or the hit's artifact) or type ids as artifact:12 event:7. The operation is all-or-nothing and is audited with the list of changed ids. A tag is a human annotation.
wb.saved.title: Saved searches
wb.saved.hint: We save the query and filters, not the results. Running it again recomputes the answer; only counts are kept.
wb.saved.name: Saved search name
wb.saved.last_run: last run {at}: {n} hits within the limit
wb.saved.confirm_delete: Delete the saved search “{name}”? Its count log is kept.
wb.tags.title: Tags
wb.tags.hint: Rename and merge are explicit, audited operations. Similar names are only a suggestion.
wb.tags.confirm_merge: Merge tags? Memberships move to the target tag and the source tags are deleted (the id lists go to the audit log).
wb.folders.title: Folders
wb.folders.subtitle: working sets of references to artifacts, events, citations, text versions and annotations
wb.folders.name: Name
wb.folders.invariant: A folder stores references only (kind + id + pinned version). Adding, removing or ordering never changes evidence.
wb.folder.status_hint: Status is computed on every read: hashes and versions recorded when the item was added are compared with the current records.
wb.folder.confirm_remove: Remove the reference from the folder? The evidence stays unchanged.
wb.folder.export_hint: References and status only; no source bytes and no text. In CSV, cells starting with = + - @ get a protective apostrophe.
wb.folder.export_cli: To a chosen new file: python -m server.app.cli workbench-folder-export {id} OUTPUT.json
wb.folder.confirm_delete: Delete the folder? Only references are removed (the list goes to the audit log); evidence stays.
wb.copy.manual: Clipboard unavailable — the text of citation #{id} is selected for manual copying.
wb.copy.failed: Could not fetch the text of citation #{id}.
wb.bookmarks.title: Timeline bookmarks
wb.bookmarks.subtitle: time points and ranges chosen by a person, with an optional reference
wb.bookmarks.label: Label
wb.bookmarks.ref_id: ID (for a segment: the artifact ID)
wb.bookmarks.confirm_delete: Delete the bookmark? Its content goes to the audit log.
wb.bookmarks.semantics: A bookmark is a position chosen by a person, not an event time. A time with an offset or Z gives a UTC instant; a time without a zone stays “zone unknown” and is left out of time windows.
wb.keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
wb.keys.hint: Press ? on any page to see the list. Configuration file: /static/workbench-keys.json.
knowledge.title: What we know / what we don't
knowledge.summary: Recorded facts: {recorded} · not recorded or unknown: {unknown}
knowledge.unknown: What is not recorded or unknown
knowledge.not_claimed: What these records do not claim
knowledge.reason.legacy_snapshot: historical snapshot; number of earlier acquisitions unknown
knowledge.reason.legacy_unknown: versions without a recorded run (provenance unknown)
knowledge.reason.unclassified_kind: text kind unknown to the layer classification
knowledge.no_unknowns: No gaps found in the fields checked by code (this does not mean the material is complete).
knowledge.claim.hash_not_authorship_trut: A matching SHA-256 proves identical bytes, not authorship, truth or time of creation.
knowledge.claim.asr_language_probability: ASR language probability is not certainty that the transcript is correct.
knowledge.claim.no_signature_or_custody: No cryptographic signature and no chain of custody.
knowledge.claim.folder_tag_membership_no: Tags, folders and bookmarks are human annotations, not evidence.
knowledge.claim.word_timing_not_verified: Word timestamps are not a verified alignment with the audio.
knowledge.computed: This summary was computed by code from stored tables; it does not rate reliability or assign numerical certainty.
knowledge.unavailable: The summary is temporarily unavailable; the evidence above is untouched.
knowledge.add_to_folder: Add the artifact to a folder
citation.copy.range: Text version #{version} ({kind}, model: {model}, language: {language}), range {start}–{end} ({start_ms}–{end_ms} ms)
citation.copy.caveat: The text is model output (ASR) for the given version; agreement with the recording has not been verified by listening.
integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: read tokens · annotation proposals · relation hypotheses (quarantine)
integrations.tokens.hint: The token value is shown once at creation (token-create); the database keeps only a salted hash.
integrations.col.label: Label
integrations.proposals.hint: A client proposal never becomes an annotation automatically. Accepting creates the annotation with recorded provenance (proposal, client, token, mode, provider, model).
integrations.hypotheses.hint: Relations returned by a graph tool (e.g. Loom) land here. Only promotion writes one row in links with an audit entry; rejection keeps the row.
